mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand shock that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises, with a Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000.0 (thousands of units), it signals a housing market collapse that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1000.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls and an increase in the unemployment rate signals a severe labor market deterioration that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0%), a decline in housing starts leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0%), the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST declines, with a Rank IC < 0.03.
